title: Objective reduction of the register superposition ends inflation

statements.text: During inflation the universe is a superposed state of quantum registers, and its self-reduction, consistent with Penrose's objective reduction, reaches the quantum gravity threshold at the end of inflation with a superposition of about $10^9$ registers.

sources.quote: The quantum gravity threshold is reached at the end of inflation, and corresponds to a superposed state of 10 9 quantum registers
